status: PROPOSED; training blocked pending Gate 1/Gate 2 readiness and release-sequence decision
hypothesis: Boosted trees can learn nonlinear effects and interactions among the 130 anonymous predictors and may outperform the constant baselines and regularized GLM.

excluded: September target summaries and derived labels

preprocessing.categorical_encoding: Native categorical features with training-derived vocabularies
preprocessing.unseen_or_missing_category: Missing categorical value handled by the learned XGBoost default branch
preprocessing.fit_scope: Refit preprocessing independently inside every CV fit portion and final training refit

target.non_finite_prediction: Fail the run and record the error
target.negative_prediction: Record and score unchanged using the shared evaluator

experiment_budget.failure_policy: Failures and retries consume allocated slots. Do not exceed 6 configurations or 30 CV fits without a written team amendment. Log unchanged independent reproductions separately.

iteration.status: Reserved for Gate 3; do not execute while release sequence is unresolved
iteration.rule: After the team resolves OCT-A2-RELEASE-SEQUENCE, freeze one justified change to one hyperparameter of the selected initial candidate, using training evidence only.
iteration.constraint: Document the change and rationale before running the sixth configuration
iteration.comparison: Record before/after pooled OOF MAE, fold counts/MAE, mean/sample SD and runtime. Also record before/after validation MAE if the team adopts gate1_two_releases.
iteration.validation_use: Do not use validation results to choose the iteration

evaluation.cv_method: Five saved folds within the training partition
evaluation.selection_metric: Pooled out-of-fold MAE in original loss units
evaluation.tie_rule: Among configurations within 1 loss unit of the minimum pooled OOF MAE, prefer lower max_depth, then fewer trees, then lower learning_rate, then lower recorded runtime.
evaluation.final_refit: Blocked until the team resolves the sequence; refit each released configuration and its preprocessing on all training claims.
evaluation.validation_release: UNRESOLVED: policy_review lists two options; neither is authorized.
evaluation.test_partition: Reserved; do not fit, tune, or evaluate on test claims during October

reproducibility.preprocessing_persistence: Save fitted rare mappings, fixed vocabularies and schema alongside model JSON.

requires: Recorded Gate 1 and Gate 2 readiness decisions
Team resolution of OCT-A2-RELEASE-SEQUENCE before candidate fits
Frozen iteration hypothesis, resource limits and deadline before execution
execution.note: Declarative hold in a scaffold; a future training runner must enforce it.

policy_review.reference: artifacts/october/gate 1/gate1_overview.md: Validation Use and Stopping Rules; OCT-G1-T4-PROPOSAL-v1
policy_review.reference_status: PROPOSED; not a recorded team approval

conflict.original_scaffold: Run the sixth configuration after initial training CV, before one final validation release.
conflict.gate1_proposal: Release the initial frozen comparison, then freeze one justified iteration and release its training-CV-selected candidate in a second comparison.

options.description: Adopt the Gate 1 sequence: initial XGBoost winner and iteration candidate each receive one full-training refit and one validation release. Record before/after validation and pooled OOF MAE. Choose iteration settings using training evidence only.

Explicitly amend the proposal to finish iteration within training before one validation release. Record before/after OOF MAE and disclose that separate before/after validation evidence will not exist. Team must decide whether this meets the iteration requirement.

policy_review.required_decision: Select and record a sequence and its comparison/selection rules before any real candidate training. Neither option is adopted by this configuration.
